name: Beta-Carboline
summary: Beta-Carboline is a documented other compound on PsychonautWiki.

pharmacology.text: The compound has been found to possess a variety of pharmacological activities, including DNA mutagenic effects, imidazoline receptor interactions, serotonin reuptake inhibition, monoamine oxidase inhibition, cytochrome P450 enzyme inhibition, and inhibition of other enzymes, among others. β-Carboline is a weak reversible inhibitor of monoamine oxidase A (RIMA), with an IC50 of 1,700 nM.
